presentation.summary: Submit Silo movie and series requests through a Seerr-compatible server.
presentation.description_markdown: Connects Silo to Seerr, including Jellyseerr and Overseerr-compatible deployments. Seerr continues to manage its own Sonarr and Radarr services while the plugin maps Silo request identities, HD and 4K intent, and request status.
presentation.setup_markdown: Install the plugin and add a Seerr connection in Silo with its base URL and an API key owned by a Seerr administrator or auto-approve user. Choose whether the connection handles 4K and whether requests should be attributed to the API-key owner or mapped to Silo users by email.

capabilities.description: Fulfill content requests through a Seerr (Overseerr/Jellyseerr) instance.

fields.label: This Seerr handles 4K requests
fields.description: Enable only if the Seerr instance has a 4K Sonarr/Radarr configured. When off, 2160p requests are not sent to this connection.

fields.label: Attribute requests to
fields.description: Admin user: all requests come from the API-key owner (auto-approved). Map to Silo users: attribute each request to the Seerr user matching the requester's email (created if missing).

fields.label: Auto-approve requests
fields.description: Mapped users' requests are auto-approved. Off: they land in Seerr's per-user approval queue.

fields.label: Fail the request if the user can't be mapped
fields.description: On: a request whose Silo user can't be matched/created on Seerr fails instead of being submitted under the admin.
